sections.description:
SIND DIVISIONAL AND
SIND DIVISIONAL AND DISTRICT CO‑ORDINATION
COMMITTEES (CONSTITUTION) RULES, 1980
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV‑A, 17th April 1980]
No. L. O.(E)/L.G./70/79.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 103 of the Sind Local Government
Ordinance, 1979, read with section 89 thereof, the Government of Sind are
pleased to make the following rules :‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be
called the Sind Divisional and District Coordination Committees (Constitution)
Rules, 1980.
(2) These shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules unless there is anything
repugnant in. the subject or context‑
(a) "Chairman's means a Chairman of the Committee ;
(b) "Committee" means
a District Coordination Committee or Divisional Coordination Committee as the
case may be ;
(c) "member" means a
member of the Committee ; and
(d) "Schedule" means
the Schedule to these rules.
3. District and Divisional Coordination Committee.‑Where a
District or Divisional Coordination Committee is constituted, there shall be
only one such Committee for a District, or for a Division, as the case may be;
Provided that there shall be no District Coordination Committee in
Karachi Division.
4. Members of District Coordination
Committee.‑(1) A District Co ordination Committee shall consist of
eleven members belonging in the rural areas and urban areas as specified in the
Schedule;‑
(2) The members required to be
ejected shall be elected‑
(a) in the case of representation of the: rural areas from among
the members of the Union Councils and the District Councils by the members of
the District Council subject to the condition that at least two members shall
be the Chairmen of the Taluka Councils;
(b) in the case of
representation of the urban areas from amongst the members of the Councils
concerned.
5. Members of the Divisional
Coordination Committees :‑
(1) A Divisional Coordination
Committee shall consist of eighteen mem bers as, follows :‑
(a) in the case of Hyderabad
and Sukkur Division :‑
(i) the Chairman of the
District Councils ;
(ii) The Mayor of the
Corporation or Chairman of the Municipal Com mittee in the headquarters of the
districts, as the case may be;
(iii) the Chairman of the
District Coordination Committee,
(b) in the case of Karachi
Division;
(i) the Mayor of the Karachi
Metropolitan Corporation;
(ii) the Chairman of the
Karachi District Council;
(iii) thirteen members elected
from amongst the members of the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation;
(iv) Two members representing
KMC in KDA Governing Body.
(v) One member elected from
amongst the members of Karachi District Council.
6. Election of Members.‑(1) Where a member of any Committee
is to be elected from amongst the members of a Council, Government or an
officer authorized in this behalf may require the Council to call its meeting
for election of such member on such date and time as may be specified in such
requisition.
(2) Where a member of any
Committee is to be elected from amongst the Chairmen or Members of two or more Councils,
Government or an officer authorised, in this behalf may require the Chairmen or
members, as the case may be, of such Councils to assemble at the specified
date, time and place and elect such member under the Chairmanship of such
person as may be appointed by Government for the purpose.
(3) Where two or more members
of a Committee are to be elected under sub‑rule (1) or sub‑rule (2)
the election of all the candidates shall be held at one and the same time and
the requisite number of the candidates receiving higher votes in descending‑order
shall stand elected, and if there is a tie between two or more candidates in
the lowest place the result shall be pronounced by drawing lots. For the
purpose one member will .have only one vote to be cast in favour of only one
candidate.
